change: Added Trailer Status — Yard Inventory to Support Services > Trailers, matching the fleet's shared Excel format (SrNo, Trailer Type, Running Fleet, AuxNo, RegistrationDate, ModelName, ChassisNo, Remark, Staus, Location). Upload Excel button parses and imports the sheet directly (auto-detects the right sheet even with a pivot-summary sheet present), with a live summary (In Yard / Working Condition / Flat Bed / Needs Repair / Left-Duplicate) and a color-coded, repair-priority-sorted table. Download button exports back to the same format. This is separate from the existing Log Trailer Job / Trailer Log job-tracking feature, which is unchanged.
